title: Objects arrive
caption: Two teak chairs, two books and a few gulmohar petals fall from above into a nearly empty dawn atmosphere. The house is fully hidden.

title: Into the house
caption: The same objects descend and become faint. A small line reads “Make room for what comes next.”

title: Dawn / house at rest
caption: The confirmed house appears intact, with the stepped roof, teak windows, grey gate and two sparse gulmohars. Four corners read SPACE / Book a call / Scroll / 06:00 IST.

title: The first separation
caption: Floors begin parting vertically; fine survey lines in empty space describe the separation. No geometry rotates or breaks.

title: A house for startup people
caption: The parting reaches its widest point. Copy: “A house for startup people. Four levels. Room to belong.” Seam glow is removed in this refinement.

title: An empty breath
caption: Only a very faint upper silhouette and the corner HUD remain. This is a deliberate quiet interval.

title: Work / lower level
caption: A compact lower-level section reveals work space, the large-tree court, a separate open-to-sky access court and a distinct garage-ramp edge. “Work, with room to think.” leads to Explore.

title: Lower level leaves
caption: The same section drifts up, with the table and floor disappearing first. Its caption and leader withdraw.

title: Morning pause
caption: The viewport is empty warm-grey fog with four quiet corners.

title: Coffee / ground floor
caption: The teak-floored living room appears with the glazed doors, brass lanterns and two small tables. “Coffee. A table. An unhurried start.” accompanies the café hours, 08:00–18:00.

title: The morning clears
caption: The café moves upward and its floor is veiled; all in-world copy has faded.

title: Afternoon pause
caption: An empty afternoon atmosphere separates café and courtyard.

title: Read / first floor
caption: The approved double-height court returns: olive tree, three nest pendants, sandstone and louvred teak. A library glimpse is a proposed adjacent use. The caption reads “Read. Talk. Let an idea take its time.”

title: Who’s inside
caption: A slightly wider court view makes space for Founders / Artists / Music / Play. Founders is selected; two people talk over a notebook. Labels and short callout lines live in empty fog.

title: Into sundown
caption: The screen becomes empty violet-grey fog. The rejected pass that invented a new terrace was replaced.

title: Terrace / sundown
caption: The full narrow terracotta terrace, white parapet openings, teak side room and timber bench appear. Three people talk under restrained warm lights. “The day opens into evening.”

title: Evening pause
caption: Empty slate-blue atmosphere deepens toward night.

title: Coming back together
caption: The familiar facade comes back almost closed, with narrow seams and the first warm windows. The initial roof separation resolves as scrolling continues.

title: A club by night
caption: The closed house glows softly. The copy explains evening hours, 18:00–23:00, and membership-dependent access. No programme frequency is invented.

title: Night pause
caption: The house vanishes into empty deep-blue mist.

title: Three ways to belong
caption: Visit, Regular and House appear as three furniture compositions on small sandstone fragments. Each lists inclusions, “Needs —” and Book a call. Requirements remain visibly unconfirmed.

title: Regular / selected
caption: The Regular object brightens subtly with an underline and orange focus dot. The other two remain readable. The helper line says “For a more regular rhythm.”

title: One last breath
caption: The three objects withdraw. “Stay a while” replaces the scroll hint as the final empty interval arrives.

title: There’s room for you
caption: One empty teak chair and one petal form the final in-world invitation. “There’s room for you. Tell us what you’re building. Book a call →.” The top-right action remains.

title: Mobile / dawn
caption: Whole facade, portrait composition and location copy.

title: Mobile / first floor
caption: Complete courtyard above its caption and Explore action.

title: Mobile / memberships
caption: Regular selected, with direct tier labels and visible previous/next controls.

title: Mobile / invitation
caption: One chair and a quiet booking invitation.

title: Explore / closed + focus
caption: Underline, dot and leader redraw; the world remains readable.

title: Explore / open + decoded
caption: Longer content, a dimmed court, walkthrough and call actions.

title: Who’s inside / Artists
caption: Sketching, shared perspectives and unchanged architecture.

title: Who’s inside / Music
caption: A small acoustic conversation; no stage or crowd.

title: Who’s inside / Play
caption: Two people and one quiet board game.

title: Loading
caption: One petal, honest status and a still-mode escape.

title: 404 / this room isn’t here
caption: A closed book, useful return navigation and booking access.

title: Booking / unavailable
caption: Honest empty-destination state; no fake times or confirmation.

title: Loading / recovery
caption: Retry or continue without motion.

title: Without motion / first chapter
caption: Still scene art with explicit chapter controls.

title: Walkthrough / courtyard
caption: Eye-level photo-grounded room tour with previous/next and return-to-story.

title: System / type + HUD
caption: Three type families, corner placement, scale and interaction states.

title: System / palette + fog
caption: House materials and five hour chips with exact hex labels.

title: System / components
caption: Actions, callouts, sound, scroll and memberships as world objects.
